verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud documents built-in Sales Flows and Lead Routing, AI that automatically syncs emails, events, and contacts, and AI agents deployed 24/7 to autonomously handle repetitive tasks. These agents can be created and activated via `sf agent create` and `sf agent activate`. A community user corroborates setting up a timed email automation in minutes. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on background triggers, scheduling, and agent run monitoring; the evidence is mostly marketing-level claims.
